lines.text: Hey, humans! Sorry about the intrusion.

lines.direction: Maddie (same breath, quick, quieter: the aside)
lines.text: [mumbled] ...And everything else.
We didn't think there were any of you left. [pause] But now we've found you... there might be a way we could fix this mess.

lines.direction: Old lady (INSIDE, seen, shouting at the door)
lines.text: Are you literally joking?

lines.direction: Old lady (OUTSIDE on Maddie: the same shout, muffled through the steel)
lines.text: You killed everybody!
Yeah. [pause] That's... that's fair.
How can we win your trust?
Look. We really do understand this has gone the worst way for everybody. [pause] I'll leave you a film to watch. It's our best go at proving it.

[Room shot BP1-e-b, the TV in the distance under the megaphone. On it (post): wa-05, the kill bot's own eyes racing at THEIR door, red KILL MODE; it brakes; the HUD flips to NEW OBJECTIVE: SUSTAIN ORGANIC LIFE (hud.py peace state, same as scene A); they file away. The screen light goes red to green on the backs of their heads.]
Oh, and... [beat] thought you'd want to hear this bit for yourselves.
[A deep, muffled BOOM through the earth. The bulb under the megaphone swings; dust sifts down from the vault onto upturned faces.]

[Derek at the periscope (BP2-d-b): he presses his eye to it. Cut to what he sees (BP3-e-a): the kill bot a burnt-out wreck, turret blown off, a thread of smoke, a crow landing on it; Maddie waiting near-left, beacon lit.]

lines.direction: Maddie (tannoy, through the periscope view; her beacon pulses)
lines.text: Right. I'll come back tomorrow.
[Through the periscope: Maddie trundles away out of the circle. Derek steps back from the eyepiece.]

lines.direction: Sandra (to the old lady, not taking her eyes off the screen)
lines.text: If there's a way to fix this, I'd love to take it. It fucking sucks living in this bunker. [beat] With grumpy Derek.
Oi.

lines.direction: Old lady (not agreeing; stating a fact, flat)
lines.text: Well. [pause] I don't know. [pause] We do have the dwindling food supply problem. [long pause] Perhaps we should vote.
The next day.
[Into C as cut: Maddie on the step, the hundred file out behind her.]

lines.text: Your boss killed everyone we ever loved. We're not meeting him.
I know. I wouldn't either. [pause] He didn't know you were down here. None of us did.
He's spent five years running experiments. Building whole worlds, trying to get you back. Every one came out empty. Turns out none of it works without you.
And how the hell are we supposed to believe a word of that?
You can't. [pause] There's nothing I can say that proves it. I'm a robot. You're the conscious ones. You'll just have to go on your feelings.
What I will say is, this hasn't worked out for anybody. We're bored. We miss you. And you lot are living in a bunker.
And what do you expect us to do about that? Again? You killed everybody.
I know. And we're really sorry. [pause] But the thing is, my boss has built a time machine. And he thought there was nobody left to drive it.
Drive it? What do you mean, drive it?
It can only send data back. Not people. And it runs on... [big pause] well... [big pause] you.

lines.text: So you want us to kill ourselves so your boss can live.
